blocks.text: Apo Hiking Society has released their latest single “Woman Divine,” a love song first written in the 1980s but was only completed in 2026. OPM artist Jim Paredes, one-half of the group alongside Boboy Garrovillo, shared the story behind the track through their Instagram page on Wednesday, Nov. 11. Paredes noted that he started writing the song after they recorded their hit “When I Met You.” “What do you do with a love song that’s been waiting nearly 40 years to be finished? I started writing it in the mid-’80s, during a very romantic, poetic time in my life. But somewhere […]...
